title: Governor JB Pritzker Rings the Opening Bell at Cboe
summary: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker joined Cboe to ring the Opening Bell, recognizing Chicago’s leadership as a global center for financial markets and innovation. Governor Pritzker was joined on stage by senior executives from Cboe, XFA, Optiver and Wedbush.
text:
Governor JB Pritzker Rings the Opening Bell at Cboe
Illinois Governor JB Pritzker visited Cboe's trading floor on October 29 and rang the opening bell alongside Cboe's leadership team and other industry leaders.
